spans.s: jaṭā-karaṇa-karman, nt., the ceremony of clipping a young boyʼs hair except for the top-knot: (Rāhulasya) ˚karma Mv 〔iii.263.16〕; = Skt. cūḍākaraṇa, which replaces this as exact synonym in line 18 below.
Jaṭāpura, n. of a town: Māy 〔77〕.
Jaṭiṃdhara, n. of a śreṣṭhin and medical authority: Suv 〔175.1 ff.〕; 〔199.10 ff.〕
Jaṭilikā, n. of a village chiefʼs daughter: LV 〔265.6〕.
